origin: The post states as fact, without a source, what the WSJ reported as unconfirmed talks from anonymous people that could still collapse or go to another buyer. "Possibly for as high as $10 billion" is hedged and matches the reported valuation, though PYMNTS says the exact price could not be learned. Nothing on the fact sheet contradicts the post, but none of it is confirmation from either company. Expected honest rating: 55 to 75.
